notes: Softball frame (fitted): the apex of home plate is at (-39.505, 817.623) (intersection of the outer edges of the two foul lines; their centrelines were fitted as brightness peaks on 12 profiles each, rms 0.04-0.05 m, and meet at 89.998 deg); 3B line -114.05 deg, 1B line -24.05 deg. Checks: home plate (brightest dot) at 0.06 m and the pitcher's plate at 0.06 m of where the rule book puts them. Everything of the diamond is computed from that frame (NCAA: 60 ft bases, 43 ft pitching distance, 8 ft circle, 3 x 7 ft batter's boxes 6 in from the plate with the front line 4 ft ahead of the plate centre, catcher's box 10 ft x 8 ft 5 in, coach's box lines 15 ft long 12 ft outside the base lines, 3 in lines with the outer edges of the foul lines on the base lines). The skin arc (R 60 ft about the front of the pitcher's plate), the warning-track edge (R 49.0) and the outfield fence (R 52.05) are all centred on the pitcher's plate, as the ortho shows (circle fits rms 0.13-0.3 m). The infield is clay (gravel here): it is uniform tan, the foul lines stop at its edge and none of the chalk lines shows, so it is not inlaid turf; chalk lines on it are listed but gravel takes no paint. Tennis: three courts fitted one by one as templates (78 x 36 ft, singles 27 ft, service lines 21 ft from the net, centre service line), centres and angles: (-52.248, 729.512) -113.905 deg; (-37.190, 722.898) -113.987 deg; (-22.187, 716.143) -113.763 deg; 16.45 m between centres. The block is drawn in the frame of court 2 with the mean angle -113.885 deg. Not drawn: the backstop, the seats behind home plate and the press box (all north of the footprint edge, y 826); light poles (none in the 2017 LiDAR, none seen in the ortho); the scoreboard (left-centre field per the athletics site, not found in the ortho); the red hawk logo painted in centre field; the red sheds south-west of the courts (outside the footprint).
